title: 秋夕
author: 杜牧
intro: A young palace woman on a cool autumn night: she swats at fireflies with a little fan, then lies down to gaze at the lovers’ stars. Not one word of complaint — every image does the work.
analysis: 这首诗写深宫里一位宫女的秋夜。第一句：白色的蜡烛照着画屏，秋夜的光显得冷清。第二句：她拿着轻罗小扇扑萤火虫。秋天了还用扇子，暗示她像夏天过后被收起的扇子一样，被冷落了；萤火虫多的地方，往往是荒凉少人的地方。第三句写夜深了，石阶凉得像水。第四句她躺下来看天上的牵牛星和织女星。传说牛郎织女每年七夕还能相会，她却只能远远地看着，那份孤独和盼望不用说出来。全诗没有一个字写“愁”，只写了动作和景物，感情却藏在每个细节里。这种写宫女寂寞生活的诗叫“宫怨诗”，这是其中最含蓄的一首。
analysisEn: This poem shows one autumn night in the life of a young woman in the imperial palace. Line one: white candles light a painted screen, and the autumn light feels cold. Line two: she flaps at fireflies with a small silk fan. Carrying a fan in autumn is a hint — like a summer fan put away when the weather cools, she has been forgotten. And fireflies gather in quiet, overgrown places where few people come. Line three: the night deepens, and the stone steps are as cool as water. Line four: she lies down and watches two stars, the Herd-boy and the Weaver-girl. In the legend these lovers are allowed to meet once a year, on the seventh night of the seventh month; she can only watch from far away. The poem never says she is sad or lonely. It shows only what she does and what she sees, and the feeling is hidden in every detail. Poems about the loneliness of palace women form a whole genre called gōngyuàn shī (“palace laments”), and this is one of the most understated.
background: Du Mu (803–c. 852) wrote many poems about palace life and the past. The poem has also been attributed to Wang Jian, but it is generally included among Du Mu’s works.
pronunciation: 卧看 kàn。“天阶”一作“天街”。
version: 采用通行本。“天阶夜色凉如水”一作“天街夜色凉如水”，“卧看牵牛织女星”一作“坐看牵牛织女星”；作者一说为王建。

lines.py: yín zhú qiū guāng lěng huà píng
lines.lit: Silver candles and autumn light make the painted screen cold;
lines.en: White candles, autumn light, a painted screen gone cold;

lines.py: qīng luó xiǎo shàn pū liú yíng
lines.lit: with a little fan of light silk she swats at drifting fireflies.
lines.en: with a small silk fan she swats at drifting fireflies.

lines.py: tiān jiē yè sè liáng rú shuǐ
lines.lit: On the palace steps the night is cool as water;
lines.en: The night on the palace steps is cool as water;

lines.py: wò kàn qiān niú zhī nǚ xīng
lines.lit: lying down, she watches the Herd-boy and Weaver-girl stars.
lines.en: she lies and watches the Herd-boy and the Weaver-girl in the sky.

words.note: 夕：傍晚、夜晚。现代汉语“七夕”“除夕”。

words.en: the Herd-boy and Weaver-girl stars (Altair and Vega)
words.note: 就是“牛郎织女”的故事，现代七夕节由此而来。

imagery.name: 烛
imagery.zh: 白色的蜡烛映着冷冷的画屏，宫中秋夜一片清冷。
imagery.en: Silver-white candles light a painted screen: the palace on an autumn night feels cold.

imagery.name: 扇
imagery.zh: 秋天还拿着扇子，暗示被冷落——夏天的扇子到了秋天就被收起。
imagery.en: A fan in autumn hints at being cast aside, like a summer fan put away when the weather turns.

imagery.name: 萤
imagery.zh: 扑萤火虫是无聊时的消遣，也说明庭院荒凉、少有人来。
imagery.en: Chasing fireflies passes the empty hours — and fireflies gather where few people come.

imagery.name: 牵牛织女
imagery.zh: 牛郎织女一年还能相会一次，她却只能躺着看星星，心里的期盼不言自明。
imagery.en: The Herd-boy and Weaver-girl stars at least meet once a year; she can only lie and watch them.
